  SELECT customer_id,

         SUM(order_sales) AS monetary

scored AS (

  FROM cust

SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last, h.games, h.runs, h.hits, h.home_runs
FROM (
  SELECT player_id, games, runs, hits, home_runs
  FROM (
    SELECT player_id, games, runs, hits, home_runs,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY games DESC) AS r_games,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY runs DESC) AS r_runs,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hits DESC) AS r_hits,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home_runs DESC) AS r_hr
    FROM (SELECT player_id, SUM(games) AS games, SUM(runs) AS runs, SUM(hits) AS hits, SUM(home_runs) AS home_runs FROM batting GROUP BY player_id)
  )
  WHERE r_games = 1 OR r_runs = 1 OR r_hits = 1 OR r_hr = 1
) h
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id;

SELECT w1.name, w2.name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id
WHERE m.title_id = (
    SELECT title_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE title_id LIKE '%NXT%'
      AND (title_change IS NULL OR title_change = 0)
    ORDER BY CAST(duration AS INTEGER) ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY CAST(m.duration AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bowler, b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, SUM(b.runs) AS runs_conceded
FROM (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.innings_no, bb.bowler, bs.runs_scored AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs
      ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.innings_no, bb.bowler, er.extra_runs AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN extra_runs er
      ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_type NOT IN ('byes', 'legbyes')
) b
GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
ORDER BY runs_conceded DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM (
  SELECT bb.match_id, bb.striker AS player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs
    ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
   AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
   AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
   AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker
  HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
) t
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = t.match_id
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = t.player_id
WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND m.match_winner <> (
    SELECT bb2.team_batting
    FROM ball_by_ball bb2
    WHERE bb2.match_id = t.match_id
      AND bb2.striker = t.player_id
    LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT strftime('%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2016' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2016",
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2017",
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2018"
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016','2017','2018')
GROUP BY strftime('%m', order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month;

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS yr,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016','2017','2018')
  GROUP BY yr
),
lowest_year AS (
  SELECT yr FROM yearly ORDER BY cnt ASC LIMIT 1
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS ym,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = (SELECT yr FROM lowest_year)
  GROUP BY ym
)
SELECT MAX(cnt) AS highest_monthly_volume FROM monthly;

SELECT c.customer_city,
       AVG(p.payment_value) AS avg_payment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM olist_orders o
JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.customer_city
ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_value) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(cat_payment_count) FROM (SELECT p.product_category_name, op.payment_type, COUNT(*) AS cat_payment_count FROM olist_order_payments op JOIN olist_order_items oi ON op.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name, op.payment_type HAVING op.payment_type = (SELECT op2.payment_type FROM olist_order_payments op2 JOIN olist_order_items oi2 ON op2.order_id = oi2.order_id JOIN olist_products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.product_id WHERE p2.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY op2.payment_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1))

WITH city_coords AS (
  SELECT customer_city AS city, customer_state AS state,
         AVG(geolocation_lat) AS lat, AVG(geolocation_lng) AS lng
  FROM olist_customers c
  JOIN olist_geolocation g
    ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY customer_city, customer_state
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT a.city AS city1, a.state AS state1, b.city AS city2, b.state AS state2,
         6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
           POWER(SIN(RADIANS(b.lat - a.lat) / 2), 2) +
           COS(RADIANS(a.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(b.lat)) *
           POWER(SIN(RADIANS(b.lng - a.lng) / 2), 2)
         )) AS distance_km
  FROM city_coords a
  JOIN city_coords b
    ON a.city < b.city OR (a.city = b.city AND a.state < b.state)
)
SELECT city1, state1, city2, state2, distance_km
FROM pairs
ORDER BY d

SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS full_name
FROM actor a
JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
JOIN language l ON l.language_id = f.language_id
JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
WHERE l.name = 'English'
  AND f.rating IN ('G', 'PG')
  AND c.name = 'Children'
  AND f.length <= 120
  AND f.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name, SUM((julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) * 24) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN store s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN address a ON s.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id
JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE (ci.city LIKE 'A%' OR ci.city LIKE '%-%')
  AND r.return_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.FirstName, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS AmountSpent
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN invoice_items il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN tracks t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
WHERE a.ArtistId = (
    SELECT a2.ArtistId
    FROM invoice_items il2
    JOIN tracks t2 ON il2.TrackId = t2.TrackId
    JOIN albums a2 ON t2.AlbumId = a2.AlbumId
    GROUP BY a2.ArtistId
    ORDER BY SUM(il2.UnitPrice * il2.Quantity) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName
HAVING SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) < 1;

WITH sales_q4 AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id,
         t.calendar_year AS yr,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amt
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
totals AS (
  SELECT yr, SUM(amt) AS total_amt
  FROM sales_q4
  GROUP BY yr
),
shares AS (
  SELECT sq.prod_id, sq.yr, sq.amt / tt.total_amt AS share
  FROM sales_q4 sq
  JOIN totals tt ON sq.yr = tt.yr
),
top20 AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(amt) AS total_sales
    FROM sales_q4
    GROUP BY prod_id
    ORDER BY tota

WITH dec_profit AS (
  SELECT s.cust_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS profit
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND t.calendar_year = 2021
    AND t.calendar_month_number = 12
  GROUP BY s.cust_id
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT cust_id, profit,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY profit) AS tier
  FROM dec_profit
)
SELECT tier, MIN(profit) AS lowest_profit, MAX(profit) AS highest_profit
FROM tiered
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier;

),
grouped AS (

           ELSE 'Very High'
         END AS spending_group
  FROM spending
)
SELECT spending_group,

FROM grouped

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS ratio
FROM orders o
WHERE o.store_id = (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY store_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT h.hub_name
FROM orders o
JOIN hubs h ON o.store_id = h.hub_id

GROUP BY h.hub_id, h.hub_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

WITH stack_scores AS (

),
non_stack AS (
  SELECT ms.name, ms.version, ms.step, ms.test_score, ss.stack_score

  WHERE ms.model <> 'Stack'
),
status_per_group AS (
  SELECT name, version, step,
         MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack,
         MAX(stack_score) AS stack_score

),
labeled AS (
  SELECT name, version, step,
         CASE
           WHEN max_non_stack < stack_score THEN 'strong'
           WHEN max_non_stack = stack_score THEN 'soft'

SELECT overtake_type, COUNT(*) AS overtake_count FROM overtakes WHERE lap <= 5 GROUP BY overtake_type;

WITH driver_totals AS (
  SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
driver_best AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, total_points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
  FROM driver_totals
),
constructor_totals AS (
  SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
constructor_best AS (
  SELECT year, constructor_id, total_points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
  FROM constructor_totals
)
SELECT db.year,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_na

SELECT c.name, r.year, SUM(ds.points) AS combined_points
FROM (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points
  FROM driver_standings_ext
) ds
JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
JOIN constructors c ON ds.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
JOIN (
  SELECT r.year, ds.constructor_id, ds.driver_id, MAX(ds.points) AS best_points
  FROM driver_standings_ext ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, ds.constructor_id, ds.driver_id
) best ON best.year = r.year AND best.constructor_id = ds.constructor_id AND best.driver_id = ds.driver_id
GROUP BY c.name, r.year
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.year
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
GROUP BY d.driver_id, r.year
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT res.constructor_id) = 1
AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) >= 2;

SELECT d.year,
       AVG(d.first_round) AS avg_first_round,
       AVG(d.last_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM drives d
JOIN (
    SELECT driver_id, year
    FROM drives
    GROUP BY driver_id, year
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT constructor_id) > 1
) t ON t.driver_id = d.driver_id AND t.year = d.year
WHERE d.is_first_drive_of_season = 1
  AND d.is_final_drive_of_season = 1
  AND (d.last_round - d.first_round + 1) < 3
GROUP BY d.year;
